title: Receipted delivery: carry the turn generation in AcpPromptCommand instead of reading it when the runtime takes the prompt
outcome: Receipted delivery: carry the turn generation in AcpPromptCommand instead of reading it when the runtime takes the prompt
acceptance: An ACP prompt's delivery outcome settles the receipt of the turn its command was dispatched for, carried in the command, never the session's current turn at take-up time
A test shows an ACP outcome processed after the session's turn advanced on the same runtime token leaves the newer turn's receipt untouched
